Trikafta (elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-589213  
Guideline Name 
Trikafta (elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
5/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Trikafta  
Diagnosis 
Cystic Fibrosis  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of cystic fibrosis (CF)  


=== PDF PAGE 1842 ===
Page 1842 
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or laboratory results confirming the 
presence of at least one mutation in the cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator 
(CFTR) gene  
 
AND 
 
3 - One of the following:  
 
 3.1 CFTR mutation is responsive based on clinical or in vitro data  
 
OR 
 
 3.2 CFTR mutation results in the production of CFTR protein  
 
AND 
 
4 - One of the following:  
• 
For granule packets, patient is at least 2 to less than 6 years of age  
• 
For tablets, patient is 6 years of age or older  
 
AND 
 
5 - Prescribed by, or in consultation with, a specialist affiliated with a CF care center  
 
Product Name:Trikafta  
Diagnosis 
Cystic Fibrosis  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  


=== PDF PAGE 1843 ===
Page 1843 
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Provider attests that the patient has achieved a clinically meaningful response while on 
Trikafta therapy to ONE of the following:  
• 
Lung function as demonstrated by percent predicted expiratory volume in 1 second 
(ppFEV1)  
• 
Body mass index (BMI)  
• 
Pulmonary exacerbations  
• 
Quality of life as demonstrated by Cystic Fibrosis Questionnaire-Revised (CFQ-R) 
respiratory domain score  
 
AND 
 
2 - Prescribed by, or in consultation with, a specialist affiliated with a cystic fibrosis (CF) care 
center  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
4/30/2026  
Updated dx confirmation criterion due to expanded indication, combi
ned initial auths for tablets/granules.
